notes: Narrowed sensor spread to ±0.045 m, kept sensor size 0.016 m, lowered base speed to 1.1, increased ki to 0.8 for better steady-state correction. Expected improved control stability and fewer line loss events on complex curves.
rationale: The previous iteration's wider sensor spread (±0.05 m) and larger sensor size (0.016 m) improved line detection coverage and helped the controller maintain the line better on complex curves. However, the increased base speed to 1.2 caused instability, leading to line loss and off-track termination on the s-bend track. To improve control stability and reduce line loss events, especially on the s-bend, I narrowed the sensor spread slightly to ±0.045 m to reduce noise from off-line areas, kept the sensor size at 0.016 m for robust detection, and maintained other geometry parameters unchanged to preserve stability. I lowered the base speed to 1.1 and increased the integral gain ki to 0.8 to enhance steady-state error correction in curves. I expect these changes to reduce noise, improve control stability, decrease line loss events, and increase completion rates and scores.
